author: Mark Atwood
text: Cross-ref from 831k (items 1-3 of its sibling sites fixed today; item 4 = this bead's defect, deduped here, not re-implemented): independently confirmed on worker5 that parent_map keys are DAO targets (native AddrForKey) while transit parents are link-local (dodag.preferred_parent is the DIO sender's address; canonical-source rule forces fe80), so assemble_path_from alias bridging by low-half equality cannot work post-AddrForKey. nnmc option (b) (injected resolver) has a ready primitive: LinkLayer::peer_iid_for_routable_addr (lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs:605, added by i72x.2) resolves routable->IID over the authenticated peer table; 831k's new util::l2_destination (rpl_stack/util.rs:54) is the wrapper shape that route_for and the RH3 relay now use. Note: the root's peer table only covers its DIRECT neighbors, so an injected resolver fixes only single-hop aliasing; multi-hop chains (child names grandparent's link-local transit) still need nnmc option (a) (both forms in DodagState, routable resolved at the authenticated DIO boundary) or option (c).
